title: Every sign's ruling planet
caption: Every sign has a ruling planet, and it colors how that sign loves. Find yours, then find where it sits in your chart.

beats.head: It's called your *ruler.*
beats.sub: It colors how your sign loves.

beats.head: *Mars* rules Aries.
beats.sub: Love is a chase, and they make the first move.

beats.head: *Venus* rules Taurus and Libra.
beats.sub: Taurus loves through the senses. Libra loves through harmony.

beats.head: *Mercury* rules Gemini and Virgo.
beats.sub: Gemini flirts with words. Virgo shows love in the details.

beats.head: The *Moon* rules Cancer. The Sun rules Leo.
beats.sub: Cancer nurtures quietly. Leo adores out loud.

beats.head: *Pluto* rules Scorpio.
beats.sub: All in, all the way down. Trust is everything.

beats.head: *Jupiter* rules Sagittarius.
beats.sub: Love should feel like an adventure that keeps growing.

beats.head: *Saturn* rules Capricorn.
beats.sub: Slow to start, built to last.

beats.head: *Uranus* rules Aquarius. Neptune rules Pisces.
beats.sub: Aquarius needs freedom. Pisces needs a little magic.

beats.head: Old-school charts use the *classic* rulers.
beats.sub: Mars for Scorpio, Saturn for Aquarius, Jupiter for Pisces. Both traditions count.

beats.head: Comment your sign's *ruler.*
beats.sub: Then look up where it sits in your chart.
